title: AWS EC2 Startup Shell Script Modification
description: Detects changes to the EC2 instance startup script (user data) via ModifyInstanceAttribute where requestParameters.attribute is userData. The startup script is executed as root/SYSTEM each time the instance boots, allowing adversaries to establish persistence and execute arbitrary commands. Companion to the EC2 compute configuration modification rule, which deliberately excludes userData changes.
falsePositives: Legitimate changes to instance user data by administrators or infrastructure automation.
